messages:
Elena: quick update — Alex and I are getting married this weekend! :tada: Were having a tiny family ceremony, but would love a short office get-together on Fri around 3pm for a 10-min toast + snacks. Alex is allergic to tree nuts.
Sam: YAY!!! so happy for you both :heart: ill bring something savory.
Rachael: congratulations!! ill bring a nut-free cake. do you need gluten-free too?
Elena: thank you! nut-free is essential, GF optional but helpful.
Noor: i can do a fruit + cheese platter (labelled).
Maya: happy to help set up at 2:30 and bring some battery fairy lights :sparkles:. can also take a couple of photos if you want.
Alex: thanks everyone  keeping it low-key is perfect for us. really appreciate the support.
People Ops: reminder: small desk events OK; please label allergens and clean the space after. We can order a card and simple bouquet if requested — DM People Ops by Wed EOD.
Elena: People Ops yes please on a card. ill DM wording.
Sam: should we block calendars Fri 3-3:30 for a quick heads-up?
Elena: will do and send an invite titled "Quick congratulatory toast".
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Quick congratulatory toast (Elena & Alex)" Fri Jun 13 15:00-15:30 (Conference Kitchen). Invite broadcast to #all.
Rachael: cake drop-off scheduled for 2:45.
Noor: fruit will arrive ~2:40.
Maya: setup at 2:30, plates + napkins on me.
Elena: thank you all  feeling so loved. if folks want to add a note for the card, DM me or add to the calendar event comments. see you Friday! :blush:
